title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reform act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mother's wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

title: Kantara: Chapter 1
desc: Berme discovers Princess Kanakavathi's dark alliance with an exiled magic-wielding tribe. Thus, in order to save the realm of Kantara, he unleashes the powerful Daivas on a mission.

title: Naanu Matthu Gunda
desc: Shankar, an autorickshaw driver, adopts an abandoned dog and names it Gunda. However, his life turns upside down when his affection for the canine deepens.
